Which would I choose?

Open-ear if you:

Wear headphones for 6–8 hours daily.

Experience ear fatigue or irritation.

Walk, run, or cycle outdoors.

Want to hear coworkers or family while listening.

In-ear earbuds if you:

Care about bass and music quality.

Travel frequently or work in noisy environments.

Want active noise cancellation (ANC).

Prefer more privacy when listening.

My recommendation: For all-day comfort and situational awareness, I'd lean toward open-ear. For music quality, commuting, and versatility, I'd choose traditional earbuds.
